== Notes ==

* No objective; starts Anoat with Heading For The Medical Frigate.
* Battle Plan in the starting list is dested as the Endor Effect (the strategy 'start[s] out Battle Plans'), not the Reflections III shield.

== Strategy ==

My Strategy is to do as much direct damage w/ Asteroid Sanctuary as possible. I start out Battle Plans and have wars not make one great to slow down draining and force the enemy into submission.

There is very high destiny in this deck, despite the low power of the A-wing. This also can help w/ retreival using S&KF; to retrieve everytime the shots connect.

Unfortunately I used every Asteroid Field that I have, but I am looking for a few extras from my friends...

I am going to keep a sideboard w/ me just in case I want to make a last minute change before the tournament to setup for less combat and more anti-drain.

Please help me out and tell me how I can improve the deck!
